data.name: Meteosat · thermal infrared
data.description: Infrared cloud imagery, day and night. Regional weather detail; not vessel-resolution imagery.
data.resolution: ~3 km at nadir; coarser away from satellite center

data.name: Meteosat · dust RGB
data.description: False-color atmospheric dust product; colors are not a photograph of the surface.
data.resolution: ~3 km at nadir; coarser away from satellite center

data.name: Meteosat · natural color
data.description: Visible / near-infrared composite. Daylight required; clouds can obscure the surface.
data.resolution: ~3 km at nadir; coarser away from satellite center
